messages:
Olivia (marketing): Heads-up — dashboard flagged a weird drop in webinar cohort conversion for 3/12. MQL conversion down ~28% week-over-week. Screenshot: https://app.internal/dash/shot/3k2x :thinking_face:
Ravi (growth): ugh. is that from registration -> qualified or demo-requests?
Olivia (marketing): registration -> qualified. raw counts: regs 1,420 -> 1,410 (flat), qualified 410 -> 295 (big drop).
Marco (analytics): quick query I ran: `SELECT count(*) from leads where source='webinar' and event='qualified' and date between '2024-03-12' and '2024-03-19'` — numbers match Olivia. No obvious data ingest gaps.
Nina (ops): dashbot also pinged an event-processing warning earlier today: `event-consumer lag 00:18:42` around 07:10 UTC. Could be late attributions. dashbot: event-consumer lag resolved at 07:33 UTC.
-dashbot: notice — attribution job `attribution-rolling-7d` retried 1x at 07:12 UTC for timeout.
Ravi (growth): if ingestion delay caused attribution to fall back to last-touch, that could change qualified counts if CRM dedup or enrichment failed.
Sam (product): do we have any funnel gating changes on the registration page? No A/B test rolled out right?
Olivia (marketing): No A/B from our side. We did push a small copy tweak on the CTA Sunday night (~23:45), but it was just text. No new tracking.
Marco (analytics): I pulled utm distributions for the cohort — nothing crazy. But I did see an uptick in `utm_medium=(not set)` for a ~4 hour window around 06:30-10:30 UTC.
Nina (ops): that maps to the consumer lag window. Likely events ingested late lost their utm fields because the enrichment lambda timed out. I'll open an incident ticket and flag infra.
Ravi (growth): action items: 1) Marco to re-run attribution after reprocessing window. 2) Nina to confirm enrichment retry status / incident ticket. 3) Olivia to hold public reporting to execs until we confirm.
Marco (analytics): running reprocess now — job id `reproc_20240312_1718`. ETA ~12m. I'll post output.
Olivia (marketing): thanks. if reprocess restores numbers we can annotate the weekly slide with a note. If not, we should hypothesis-test messaging change on the landing page.
Sam (product): also check CRM dedup rules — sometimes duplicates get merged into older leads and the qualified count gets suppressed. Marco, can you include CRM merge stats in the re-run?
Marco (analytics): yes — adding `crm_merge_count` to the job.
Ravi (growth): small reminder: if we end up changing attribution window to 7d->14d logs, let's surface sensitivity in the report. execs like a single metric but we need the range. :point_up:
Olivia (marketing): agreed. I'll queue a short note for Friday's KPI deck that says: "numbers pending reprocessing; potential ingestion/enrichment impact on qualified conversions."
Nina (ops): incident opened: INC-2024-1745. root cause candidate: enrichment lambda timeout during high backlog. Will post RCA once confirmed.
Marco (analytics): reproc done — preliminary: qualified restores to 402 (vs 295) after reprocessing and CRM merge inclusion. Full diff and query output: https://app.internal/jobs/reproc_20240312_1718/output
Ravi (growth): nice — that explains it.
Olivia (marketing): phew. OK to finalize slides with note and mark as data-corrected. I'll also add a short retrospective with ops to avoid future false alarms. Thanks team :heart:
